prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable, objective “best” roofing company based on the information available. **Greener Roofing & Solar** looks like a reasonable Miami-Dade candidate to get a quote from: it advertises roof replacements designed for the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) and reports more than 100 five-star Google reviews. Those are company claims, though—not an independent endorsement.

Before choosing them or any contractor, get at least three written bids and:

- Verify the contractor’s active Florida roofing license through the [DBPR license search](https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp).
- Confirm the proposed roof assembly is approved for your address and Miami-Dade HVHZ requirements; ask for the product approval/NOA and permit details.
- Compare the full scope—tear-off, underlayment, fastening, flashing, ventilation, permits, inspections, and cleanup—not just the price.
- Check recent local references, insurance, workmanship warranty, and who will supervise the job.

A “hurricane-rated” material alone doesn’t guarantee a hurricane-compliant roof; the complete system and installation matter.
